I have created the brick-breaker game in [index.html](file:///C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/gemini_t2_r3/work/index.html).

### Features Included
- **5 Distinct Levels**: Each level (1–5) has its own brick layout and point tiers; clearing level 5 displays `"You win"`.
- **Lives & Game Over**: Starts with 3 lives (`Lives: 3`), loses 1 life when the ball falls past the paddle, and displays `"Game over"` at 0 lives.
- **Status Bar**: Renders `"Score: N"`, `"Lives: N"`, `"Level: N"`, and `"Best: N"` on both the HUD and canvas.
- **Pause (`P`) & Next Level (`N`)**: Pressing `P` toggles pause (`"Paused"`, freezing all movement), and pressing `N` skips to the next level.
- **Persistent Progress**: Saves the current level and best score in `localStorage` across page reloads.
- **Keyboard & Mouse Controls**: Move the paddle with `ArrowLeft`/`ArrowRight` or mouse movement, and launch the ball with `Space` or mouse click.
